name: Cesium
description: Integrates the CesiumJS 3D geospatial library with Drupal via Geofield, providing a globe field formatter and a Views map style.
project_description: CesiumJS is an open-source JavaScript library for world-class 3D globes and maps. The Cesium module integrates the self-hosted CesiumJS library with Drupal through the Geofield module. It provides a 'Cesium Globe' field formatter that renders a geofield's point on an interactive 3D globe, and a 'Cesium 3D Map' Views style that plots multiple result rows on a single globe. A site-wide settings form selects the minified/unminified library variant, stores a Cesium Ion access token, and toggles Cesium World Terrain and OSM Buildings. The CesiumJS library itself is served from the local /libraries/cesium directory (installed via the npm-asset/cesium package through Asset Packagist) rather than from a CDN.
